attacks.name: Freezing Blast
steps: After each attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Slow|: After each attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§slow§Slow| special condition.

attacks.name: Chill
steps: |!wild| |*Stagger|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition.

superPowers.name: Freeze and Fade
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately makes an attack action followed by a move action. This character counts as |!size| 5 during this move action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Ice Slide
superPowers.body: During this character's Activation, when it begins a move action within |!range| 2 of another allied character of |!size| 2 or less, it may use this superpower. After this move action is resolved, Place the allied character within |!range| 2 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Cold Snap
superPowers.body: When an enemy character ends a move action or attack action within |!range| 2 of this character, it gains the |§slow§Slow| special condition. If the enemy character already has the Slow special condition, it suffers 1 |!damage| instead.
